responsibility: Declares the explicit-cast checker used by the Rust typechecker. The TypeCastRules class exposes the entry point for resolving an explicit cast between two TyTy::TyWithLocation values and organizes the internal checks for general cast validation, pointer/reference cast handling, and cast-specific diagnostics, distinct from the broader coercion engine it builds upon.
same_name_distinction: Declares the TypeCastRules API and its helper entry points for explicit cast validation. Unlike rust-casts.cc, it does not execute cast-rule matching or emit cast errors; it only exposes the cast-checker structure used by the rest of the typechecker.
